owner-approved security fix 2026-11-05 (#498): a TOTP time-step counter is single-use per user and factor; Go re-accepts a still-valid code once its rolling 30-second guard elapses. Rust claims the counter atomically under FORCE RLS (V278 totp_counter_claims), so the replay is refused with 401 and counts as a failure.
